portal_hypertension.title: Response to correspondence on "Non-selective beta blockers are well tolerated in pregnancy with portal hypertension".
portal_hypertension.journal: Indian journal of gastroenterology : official journal of the Indian Society of Gastroenterology
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：PubMed 没有可用的摘要。 临床提示：对“非选择性β受体阻滞剂在妊娠合并门静脉高压症中的耐受性良好”的回复。
